page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-288-lssd-metal is a bare-metal server instance configured with 288 vCPUs across 144 physical Intel Xeon 6985P-C cores. Operating at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, this server features 2232 GB of high-speed DDR5 memory running at 6 GHz, providing approximately 7.75 GB of RAM per core. The hardware configuration includes 16242 GB of local NVMe SSD storage distributed across six drives, with no integrated GPU accelerators.

Benchmark evaluations demonstrate top-tier multi-core processing and memory bandwidth capabilities. The server achieved a multi-core stress-ng score of 313,266.86 and a Passmark CPU score of 178,741.62, both placing in the top decile. Memory bandwidth is exceptionally high, with read-only small block cached transfers reaching 23,041.86 GB/sec and large block uncached reads at 1,090.21 GB/sec. Database operations and key-value store performance are also highly competitive, as evidenced by a Redis SET throughput of 422.06 million operations per second and a Passmark database score of 39,491.44.

While multi-threaded execution, cryptography, and compression benchmarks are strong, single-core performance is moderate, with a stress-ng single-core score of 2,301.49. Additionally, LLM text generation speeds are limited, recording 41.9 tokens per second for a small 135M model. Given the massive memory capacity, high-speed local NVMe storage, and dense multi-core architecture, this server is optimized for memory-intensive databases, large-scale data processing, enterprise virtualization, and high-throughput web serving.
